summary_1line: After Bali’s death, Sugriva is overcome with guilt, lamenting fratricide while Tara mourns and begs Rama to kill her so she may reunite with her husband.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada clings to the blood-covered body of his father Bali while Tara collapses beside the fallen king in grief.
Sugriva stands before Rama with tear-filled eyes, confessing remorse while Bali’s corpse lies behind him on the battlefield.
Tara, trembling with sorrow, approaches the radiant Rama and begs him to strike her with the same arrow that killed Bali.
